description: Apply styling to existing text in place (no content change), the way you select text in Docs and apply formatting. Pick ONE target: `from` (+ optional `to`) to style a selection — from the start of the unique `from` snippet to the end of the unique `to` snippet (omit `to` to style just `from`); or `whole_document: true` to style the entire doc/tab (e.g. one font throughout, without per-paragraph calls). Styles: bold/italic/underline/strikethrough, color (hex), fontSize (pt), fontFamily, link, paragraph alignment, and paragraph spacing (spaceBefore/spaceAfter in pt, lineSpacing %). Use get_style first to read current spacing/fonts. Prefer this over rewriting the text with edit_doc and a `<span style="…">`: that also works, but it makes you restate the whole run, and retyping text is how text gets silently dropped. NOTE: a direct style change, not a tracked suggestion.

account.description: Google account email to use. Defaults to GDOCS_DEFAULT_ACCOUNT, or the sole account.

from.description: start anchor: a unique text snippet to style from (quote a slice from read_doc). Required unless whole_document is set.

page.description: which header/footer, when a doc defines more than one (default-page, first-page, even-page). Omit to use whichever exists.

segment.description: which content tree to target: body (default), or the page header/footer. Header/footer content is invisible to a body read — a letterhead logo lives there.

spaceAfter.description: points of space below the paragraph

spaceBefore.description: points of space above the paragraph

tab.description: Target a specific tab by tabId or title (from list_tabs). Defaults to the first tab.

to.description: optional end anchor: a unique snippet; styles the whole span from the start of `from` to the end of `to` (a selection). Must appear after `from`.

whole_document.description: style the entire document (or tab, or the targeted header/footer) instead of a selection — e.g. to set one font throughout. Mutually exclusive with from/to.

name: set_style
title: Style text in a doc
